item.title: After 31 Climate Summits, It Is Time to Reform the COPs
item.description: The COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, ended recently without an overarching political agreement. item.title: Maritime trade stagnates amid geopolitical uncertainty
item.description: Seaborne trade that underpins the global economy continues to slow, while disruption from conflict and climate-related factors is hitting least-developed economies and small island nations hardest, UN economists said on Thursday.

item.title: DR Congo: Peacekepers step up civilian protection amid fighting in Ituri
item.description: United Nations peacekeepers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have stepped up efforts to protect civilians in Ebola-hit Ituri province following renewed armed clashes in Djugu territory.
